title: Sparse signed-alignment estimator nonvacuity audit
scientific_scope: synthetic sparse quadratic Markov score estimation; no learning trajectory or benchmark return

mandatory_gates.E1: all rows finite, action sets complete, and total charged samples equal 2m
mandatory_gates.E2: favorable mean absolute optimized-score error divided by its registered bound <= 1.0
mandatory_gates.E4: favorable median two-times-uniform-error to true best-second margin <= 0.75
mandatory_gates.E5: adverse median relative error is at least 1.5 times the favorable median
mandatory_gates.E6: analytic Markov RMS is nonincreasing in m and nondecreasing in rho for every matched cell
mandatory_gates.E7: favorable ranking accuracy >= 0.75 for each registered dependency degree
mandatory_gates.E8: control and update rollout identifiers are disjoint and every generated sample is charged
mandatory_gates.E9: byte-identical clean reproduction, authorized only if E1-E8 all pass

stopping_rule: Any failure among E1-E8 stops reproduction and any successor learning pilot. Gates, populations, seeds, and thresholds remain frozen.
compute: local CPU only; no GPU, HPC4, or remote storage
